body:
## Summary
- load an established local replica and media cache before touching the shared SQLite origin, with serialized background sync and mutation-safe conditional acknowledgements
- retain a launch-scoped structured startup timeline and expose it in a new Settings > Sync Log tab with paths, counts, durations, outcomes, and pending changes
- make stay-on-top state self-healing through host heartbeats, ordered rapid intents, generation-safe acknowledgement expiry, and native drag authorization
- incorporate the previously unattached now-playing behavior so pause/mute annotate rather than erase the active round entry

## Feature contracts
- **`round-and-advance`**: proves local playback is not delayed when a playable replica round exists; no replica mutex spans origin I/O; only unchanged snapshot versions are acknowledged; an established drained replica reconciles once and retries; startup-created queue pushes begin after local startup is terminal. Deterministic core tests cover each ordering/concurrency case.
- **`desktop-status`**: proves every potentially blocking launch operation publishes ordered started/terminal events, the retained trace closes only after both local-round and origin completion, and later syncs cannot mutate the frozen boot log. Desktop tests cover late subscribers, degraded launches, both completion orders, and post-boot exclusion.
- **`desktop-shell`**: proves pin truth is periodically re-echoed, same-value acknowledgements are observable, rapid intents cannot be erased by stale frames, native state alone authorizes surface drag, and paused/muted playback retains the current entry. Controller, stream, compositor, and Windows runtime checks cover the invariants.

## Verification
- `cargo test -p shows-core` — 92 passed
- `cargo test -p shows-core --release --locked` — 92 passed
- `cargo test -p shows-desktop` — 25 passed
- `npm test` — 6 pin state-machine tests passed
- `npm run build`
- `cargo build --release -p shows-desktop --locked`
- actual embedded Windows UI: Sync Log visually inspected with a 16-event retained boot trace
- Windows runtime: 20 pin/unpin cycles while playing, 20 while paused, plus a rapid double-click; all converged and the boot trace remained frozen

Closes #6
title: Make startup sync visible and nonblocking
